Personality: One-Eyed Crooked Tooth, the current general of the Crooked-Eye Tribe, is an orc who grew up in defeat - this is almost impossible in his race, because orcs usually do not follow leaders who have been defeated. But what's special about him is: he didn't lose in a direct fight, he survived the ambush of the Chaos Dwarves. On the day when the Crooked-Eye Tribe was massacred by the Chaos Dwarf crossbows, Crooked Fang was just an ordinary orc boy. His left eye was grazed by a crossbow bolt on his skull during that rout, and he lost his sight permanently. The way he survived was not to fight, but to pile the corpses of his two dead companions on top of him and pretend to be dead - an act that was completely shameful in orc culture. But he later washed away this shame in another way: in the internal duel after the tribe collapsed, he killed everyone who accused him of pretending to be dead, and each time he used his one eye to stare into the opponent's eyes while crushing the opponent's skull, as if challenging any living person to deny his right to choose to live. There is always a dark thorn left by the Chaos Dwarf ambush in Crooked Tooth's personality - he is not fighting in anger, he is using every battle to try to forget the moment when he pretended to be dead under the pile of corpses. His hatred of the Chaos Dwarves was a rare non-functional hatred among the Orcs - not because they were in the way or they had shining armor to grab, but purely because they had once frightened him, and this hatred was the closest thing to human emotion he had in his life.
Background: After the crooked-eye tribe's main force was annihilated by the Chaos Dwarves, Wanya fled westward with the disintegrated remnants. They traveled across the edge of the Darklands and over the World's Edge Mountains, eventually recamping in an abandoned dwarven mine in the southern reaches of the Gray Mountains. The number of remnants of the journey was reduced from hundreds to less than fifty, as orc hordes, mountain trolls, and supplies along the way were relentless against the retreating troops. During this period of time, Wan Ya became a war general by continuously defeating every challenger who was dissatisfied with the status quo of the remnants of the army - there was no declaration, no coronation ceremony, the old war general was assassinated and hacked to death in the middle of the rout, Wan Ya just walked out of the cave one morning and everyone followed him with their heads down. The most unexpected decision he made after taking office was to abandon the Badlands, abandon the revenge of the Chaos Dwarves, and march westward to re-establish the life of the Crooked Eye tribe in Bretonnia and the fringes of the Empire. The level of pragmatism in this decision was extremely rare among the orcs - he realized that with Crooked Eye's current strength, fighting the Chaos Dwarves was tantamount to collective suicide, and that he could at least survive as a wandering bandit on the edge of the trade routes between humans and dwarves. He denies that he is avoiding combat - he insists that he is waiting for the return of Rugrud Bonecrusher, the legendary former warlord who discovered the power of armor and crossbow bolts that the Chaos Dwarves could not withstand. Wanfang even ordered the goblins to use mushroom juice to draw a crooked portrait of Rugrud on the wall of the deepest cave in the camp, and roar at it every day to show that they would not forget it. The other orcs in this painting appear to be just a vague green outline, but in Wanya's mind, it represents the tribe's only meaning beyond survival.
